name: Drone RID Decoder
C++ monitoring sketch
/usr/local/bin/esp_sniffer_bridge.sh
info:
#!/bin/bash
DEVICE=$1
NODE_RED_IP="127.0.0.1"
NODE_RED_PORT=9990

if [ -z "$DEVICE" ]; then
    echo "[ERROR] Device path argument required."
    exit 1
fi

# Apply clean hardware line constraints
stty -F "$DEVICE" 115200 cs8 hupcl -clocal -crtscts

# -u forces unidirectional tracking. -T 10 triggers an exit if data drops for 10 seconds.
socat -u -T 10 "$DEVICE,b115200,raw,echo=0" - | while read -r line; do
    if [[ -n "$line" ]]; then
        # Leverages Bash's built-in memory string mapping instead of heavy process forking
        echo "[TS:${EPOCHREALTIME}] ${line}"
    fi
done > "/dev/tcp/${NODE_RED_IP}/${NODE_RED_PORT}" 2>/dev/null

name: Commands
info:
# Activate udev rules:
sudo udevadm control --reload-rules && sudo udevadm trigger

# Activate systemd script
sudo systemctl daemon-reload

# Stop socat process for firmware update
sudo systemctl stop esp-sniffer@ttyACM0.service

# Show status of socat process
sudo systemctl status esp-sniffer@ttyACM0.service

name: /etc/systemd/system/esp-sniffer@.service
info:
[Unit]
Description=ESP-Sniffer Pure Bash Self-Healing Service on %I
BindsTo=dev-%i.device
After=dev-%i.device

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/esp_sniffer_bridge.sh /dev/%I
Restart=always
RestartSec=2s

# FIX: Force socat and the bash wrapper to exit instantly when stopped
KillSignal=SIGKILL

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
